text:
mina (People Ops): hey @diego.newhire  welcome! quick note on Day 1 logistics since you're onboarding from outside the US  Earth
- I-9: international hires w/o SSN usually do Section 1 now and Section 2 within 3 days after arrival. we can do the kiosk option on Day 2 if flying in.
- background check: county-level docs may need manual signature (VeriClear)
- benefits: domestic-partner forms differ, @anna can advise.

diego.newhire: thanks @mina. i don't have an SSN yet  worried about payroll. can I still start remote? also VeriClear asked for "local criminal records" and i'm not sure what to upload.

mina (People Ops): yes, you can start. payroll: we put you on pay once we have tax docs + SSN arrival; if SSN pending, payroll team will provision provisional records and update later. i'll flag payroll. for VeriClear, upload the country-level certificate they request (if unavailable, upload a screenshot of the request page and tag people-ops).

tony (People Ops): @diego if you arrive in SF within 3 business days, we can complete Section 2 in person at the kiosk. if you're remote longer, you must present ID within 3 days to a local authorized agent; we have a partner network in some cities. share your arrival ETA and we'll advise.

diego.newhire: arriving Monday evening. can i book a kiosk for Tue morning?

mina (People Ops): yes. kiosk slots: Tue 09:30, 10:15, 14:00. which works? bring ORIGINAL passport + visa documents. check-in code: RW-INT-212.

diego.newhire: booking 09:30 please. also laptop delivery  package shows "exception" in tracking.

it-ops-bot: Courier update for diego.newhire  package #PKG-5592: status "delivery exception - customs paperwork". ETA updated: 2 business days. Contact courier with customs reference CUS-889.

mina (People Ops): ack, i'll loop in IT & courier. @it-ops-bot can IT hold a loaner at kiosk if laptop delayed?

it-ops-bot: yes, we can reserve a loaner for kiosk pick-up. please confirm serial preference (Mac/Win).

diego.newhire: Mac please. much appreciated.

anna (Benefits): hi @diego for benefits: if your domestic partner is outside the US, we need notarized "domestic partner affidavit" translated + apostille. if you want to defer enrollment until you have SSN, you can submit a waiver now and enroll retroactively within 30 days of SSN.

diego.newhire: i need that affidavit template. can you drop it here?

anna (Benefits): uploading template to your onboarding portal and emailing you. subject: "Domestic Partner Affidavit - Redwood Benefits".

diego.newhire: thanks. last Q: VeriClear portal shows a "consent form - county records" that asks me to sign via DocuSign but the email is to a uk address. is that normal?

mina (People Ops): sometimes county vendors route via regional doc signers. if the DocuSign sender looks like VeriClear or Redwood vendor, it's fine. check sender email domain and reply here if unsure. never sign if the link looks off.

diego.newhire: verified sender domain veri-clear.co.uk so ok. i signed.

courier-bot: Courier update: customs paperwork cleared for PKG-5592. Delivery rescheduled to next business day morning.

tony (People Ops): all set: kiosk booked Tue 09:30 (check-in code above), loaner Mac reserved for pickup, VeriClear link completed, benefits template sent. payroll flagged for SSN pending. we'll send Day 1 agenda Monday morning. welcome aboard  party_popper

diego.newhire: huge thanks everyone  excited to meet the team.
